```python
p = 250000
apr = 0.07
years = 5
r = apr / 12
n = years * 12

# Formula: M = P [ r(1 + r)^n ] / [ (1 + r)^n – 1 ]
numerator = r * (1 + r)**n
denominator = (1 + r)**n - 1
m = p * (numerator / denominator)

print(f"r: {r}")
print(f"n: {n}")
print(f"numerator: {numerator}")
print(f"denominator: {denominator}")
print(f"m: {m}")
```
